description_en: Updates the status of an instance endpoint
description_zh: 更新实例访问入口状态
kebab_example: aliyun cr update-instance-endpoint-status --instance-id cri-kmsiwlxxdcva0000 --biz-endpoint-type internet --enable false --module-name Chart --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateInstanceEndpointStatus

parameters.help_en: The type of the endpoint. Set the value to Internet
parameters.name: endpoint_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the instance endpoint. Valid values:

`true`: enables the instance endpoint.
`false`: disables the instance endpoint
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启实例访问入口，取值：

`true`：开启实例访问入口

`false`：关闭实例访问入口
parameters.name: enable

parameters.help_en:
The name of the module that you want to access. Valid values:

`Registry`: the image repository.
`Chart`: a Helm chart
parameters.help_zh:
设置访问的模块，取值：

`Registry`：访问镜像仓库

`Chart`：访问Helm Chart
parameters.name: module_name
